title: Maternity Allowance - baby not yet born
description: A claimant reaches the baby-details section and says that their baby has not yet been born.

conversation.content: I want to apply for Maternity Allowance.
Would you like to apply for Maternity Allowance?

To receive Maternity Allowance, you must meet ALL of the following criteria:

• You are NOT receiving Statutory Maternity Pay (SMP) from any employer.
• You were employed or self-employed for at least 26 weeks in your 66-week Test Period.
• If doing unpaid work for a partner's business, your partner is NOT a salaried director.

Do you meet all these requirements and wish to proceed with your claim?
Before continuing, please confirm you have or can obtain the required evidence to upload during this online application: a MAT B1 maternity certificate and, if applicable, an SMP1 form.
Yes, I have the evidence I need.
Claiming Maternity Allowance may reduce or affect payments for other benefits you or your partner get. Do you confirm you understand these effects and wish to continue claiming Maternity Allowance?
Yes, I understand and want to continue.
We will now ask questions about you, including your National Insurance Number, personal contact details and residential address. Please enter your National Insurance Number to verify your identity.
We found identity records for Jane Mary Smith at 42 High Street, Flat 3B, Manchester, M1 4BT. Are these details correct?
We will now ask you questions about your baby, in particular your expected or actual childbirth date and maternity evidence.
Has your baby already been born?
